cohort: The study included 29 healthy women who had been administered morphine for anesthetic analgesia postpartum.
finding: Morphine administration, regardless of route, slightly reduced IL-2 expression in CD4 cells, with intravenous or epidural routes tending to reduce IFN-gamma expression in CD8 cells, and various routes showing differential effects on IL-6, IL-10, GM-CSF, and MCP-1 production.
